metadata.description: Wire format for `GET /v1/capabilities/{capability}`: usable versions advertising the capability and refused versions that would also have matched. Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/capabilities.rs` (`Response`, `Hit`, `lookup`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/capabilities_response/`.
The requested capability as supplied by the caller.
How many usable hit rows the response carries. Bounded by construction and checked at the wire boundary.
Every usable version advertising the capability, in lookup order. Required even when empty.
Refused versions that would have matched the capability, absent when none exist.
One usable package version advertising the requested capability.
The semantic version advertising the capability.
The entry's own capability spelling selected by prefix overlap, or null when no concrete spelling was retained. The key is always present.
One package version this build refuses and the recovery recipe, mirroring `crates/vibe-index/src/index/quarantine.rs::Unavailable`.
The refused version's bare package name.
Reader capabilities unknown to this build, in record order.
The generated explanation and fix surface for the refusal.
